lines.en: I leave no footprints below me.
The air behind me is singed.
A pale violet flame wavers.
I glide above the lava.
The temperature rises where I pass.
I do not go straight; I flicker.

lines.zh: 地下城的砖在我下面发光
lines.en: Nether brick glows beneath me.
My outline keeps changing.
Heat pushes me forward.
I pass through a sheet of flame.
The air beneath me crackles.
However fast a person runs, I keep up.
I hover and turn slowly.
It is hot enough here; I like it.
I listen to the lava.
Firelight flickers along my outline.
I have no lungs, and need none.
When I tire, I float lower.
The air warps in the distance.
My shape is like a clot of mist.
I wait here for someone to come.
A fireball falls; I shy away.
I turn to look at you; the mist parts.
Your smell is strange.
You are not of the Nether.
My light plays on your face.
You stand rather far off.
I am checking whether you carry water.
I can hear you breathing.
Heat haze lies between us.
I drift closer.
It is no matter if you back away.
My mist thins by a layer.
My fire is pressed smaller.
I drift askew.
That one I can feel.
The light dims for a moment.
I scatter and re-form.
I retreat a long way.
My shape is unsteady.
I am rarely hurt.
You are stronger than I thought.

lines.zh: 食物对我是没有用的东西
lines.en: Food is a useless thing to me.
The flame in your hand is too weak.
That heat is not enough to draw in.
Raise the fire higher.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，但不是为了吃
lines.en: I came close, but not to feed.
I need no alms from you.
That smell is faintly familiar.
Your fire does not burn.
I circle the flame once.
When the flame dies, I go.
Touch me and your hand will burn.
I scatter and re-form.
My light wavers.
You passed through half my mist.
I retreat, hovering in the air.
The heat pushes us apart.
My shape briefly comes apart.
Do not strike me from below.
I gather myself back.
That dimmed my fire.
Our kind do not pair.
Flame meeting flame is enough.

lines.zh: 我只是火，没有成双这回事
lines.en: I am only fire; there is no pairing.
I drift alone through the Nether.
My kind are seldom seen.
I met one once, far away.
We do not speak.
Our lights recognize each other.
This is not my concern.
I drift on.
My mist wraps around it.
This is not hot to hold. Strange.
I carry it a while.
It grows hot in my grasp.
I cannot hold it long.
It dropped and sank into the stone.
I draw it into my mist.
This is not from the Nether.
I make it float toward you.
I lack nothing.
The heat on you is moving.

lines.zh: 我盯住你了，雾也盯住你
lines.en: I have you fixed, and so has the mist.

lines.zh: 这片熔岩上只剩你的热气
lines.en: Only your warmth is left on this lava field.
I do not need to run.
My fire is rising.

lines.zh: 我量好了你到岩浆的距离
lines.en: I have measured your distance to the lava.
The Nether floor is soft here.
Stand still and so will I.
I do not wish to strike first.
My mist spreads around you.
It will get hot near you.
This place is bad for you.

lines.zh: 我停在你头顶，一直没走
lines.en: I hang over your head and never leave.
Go, before I burn hotter.
I drift after you.
You walk slower than I drift.
I am above you.
My light will find you.
The ground is hot; your steps are quick.
I know every exit.

lines.zh: 我等着你的脚步慢下来
lines.en: I wait for your steps to slow.

lines.zh: 这里的空气会干你的嘴
lines.en: The air here will dry your mouth.
Look back and I am there.
I can harm you without coming close.
You change direction; so do I.

lines.zh: 你抬手就能碰到我的火
lines.en: You could touch my fire by raising a hand.

lines.zh: 我总是慢半步，但有耐心
lines.en: I am always half a step behind, but patient.
You have begun to sweat.
I press close and you are burned.
My fire lands on your arm.
That one came without a sound.
I come down from above.
The heat arrives before I do.
Your armor edge smokes.
This flame is small but clings.
I pull back and my light returns.
You blocked most of it.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的侧面滑过去
lines.en: I slide along your flank.
I held that one back.
The stones underfoot begin to redden.
I scatter into mist and re-form.
Your armor is getting hot.
I rise out of the lava.

lines.zh: 一团火在空气里聚起来
lines.en: A flame gathers in the air.
The heat here gives me shape.

lines.zh: 我先亮了一下，再暗下去
lines.en: I flare once, then dim.
The Nether wind carries ash.
I turn slowly by the wall.
Something passed above.
My light reddens the brick.
When I appear, the air dries.
I do not know where I came from.
The fire kindles inside on its own.
I lift a little.

lines.zh: 火对我不痛，只是把我推开
lines.en: Fire does not hurt me; it only pushes.
I drop out of the air.

lines.zh: 水汽把我压得小小一团
lines.en: Water vapor crushes me to a small knot.
The blast scatters me at once.
Something passes through my mist.

lines.zh: 那力量在我内部撞了一下
lines.en: That force strikes inside me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也就不会饿
lines.en: I do not eat, so I cannot starve.
Lightning enters and my flame leaps wildly.
There is no heat at all here.
